fusions.name: Cold Ram
fusions.desc: A ramming strike that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's resistances and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchor Dropped
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy weight where you stand: every enemy within 3 tiles takes a blow that deals 14 damage and is [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Collision Mat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 25 damage and holds for 10 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Waterline Belt
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you carry 10% arcane resistance.
